technical_debt.title: Add a resolved-tasks / engineering-impact column to project details
scope: Add a required highlights string array to every project object in the primary and fallback registries.
Validate highlights during catalog loading and keep both registries synchronized.
Render a third project-detail metadata block beside Mode and Direction.
Use a three-column desktop layout and a vertically stacked mobile layout with resilient text wrapping.
Provide engineering-impact highlights for the eight flagship projects; define equivalent highlights for catalog modules when applying the schema.

vpfarm: Integrate inventory and livestock accounting using SQLite or Supabase.
Account for 152-FZ requirements when processing personal data in inquiry forms.
Optimize catalog loading and mobile form operation for slow or unstable connections.
bibliotheca: Keep archive browsing in an autonomous static environment without mandatory external dependencies.
Serve pages without relying on heavy relational databases.
Reduce availability dependence on external servers and APIs.
faralab: Calculate service costs based on optics type and complexity.
Accept inquiries quickly with background spam-bot protection.
Adapt service browsing and inquiry submission to mobile devices.
vk_factory: Transform source audio notes and raw notes into publication drafts through a content pipeline.
Preserve author style, structure, and source logic using PPC methodology and the Hard Outcome principle.
Control processing stages and require editor acceptance before publication.
herbarium: Build document layouts in a client-side browser constructor.
Validate user fields and control document element generation.
Assemble and export vector PDF documents in the browser.
techbase: Search technical PDF manuals and service-equipment documentation with RAG.
Keep the knowledge base in an organization-controlled environment.
Speed up retrieval of specifications, torque values, and service diagrams.
closed_control: Operate an isolated control environment on a private VDS server.
Avoid external counters, metrics, and public entry points as required by the project architecture.
Protect communication channels and apply role-based access control.
rf_smeta: Use Decimal arithmetic for exact financial calculations and avoid binary floating-point errors.
Protect access to estimates with access keys.
Automate generation and validation of construction-control questionnaires.

acceptance_criteria: Primary and fallback registries contain equivalent project records and highlights arrays.
Invalid or missing highlights data is handled during catalog loading.
Project details show Mode, Direction, and Engineering Impact without overlap on desktop or mobile.
